title: Person-to-Inspirational-DNA Init (IPQ-066)
description: Machine-readable Hybrid Direction + Output Intent collected on first run for any new person. System-wide hard veto: underage appearance only.

source_notes.description: Optional free-text: why this person, what era focus, known constraints

primary_era.description: Dominant visual era weight for hybrids

secondary_eras.description: Supporting eras that may contribute traits

era_weights.description: Optional numeric weights keyed by era tag

traits_that_travel.description: Traits allowed to move onto other bases (e.g. winged liner, fringe jacket language)

traits_suppressed.description: Traits to hold back from hybrids unless explicitly requested

original_traits_to_protect.description: Non-source traits of the target character that must survive the merge

original_traits_to_inject.description: Optional new traits to inject that are not from the source person

output_intent.description: Primary deliverable mode for this init

output_intent_notes.description: Optional free-text clarifying the chosen intent

selectable_options.description: Never forced. Height, holo-ear, Olivia-quality, etc. remain user-selectable.

target_character_hint.description: e.g. olivia | bunny | original — hint only, not a lock

hard_vetoes.description: Must include underage-appearance. Additional user vetoes allowed.

heat_gear_exposed.description: Heat/Gear fully exposed to the operator during collection
